<function name="PostDrawEffects" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called after rendering effects. This is where halos are drawn. Called just before <page>GM:PreDrawHUD</page> (The two hooks are basically identical).

See <page>GM:PreDrawEffects</page> for the associated hook.

<rendercontext hook="true" type="2D"></rendercontext>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
